verdict.rationale: Supabase's llms.txt points agents to a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec at supabase.com/openapi.json covering the Management API (organizations, projects, branches, configuration). A live probe confirmed that URL returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. Separately, type-safe API definitions can be generated from the database via introspection. Missing for 10: no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI spec for each project's auto-generated REST/data API (only TypeScript type generation), and no dedicated docs page describing the spec's use.
